name: Green World Fintech Service Co., Ltd.
summary: Green World Fintech Service Co., Ltd., a financial technology service company, provides third-party payment services in Taiwan. The company offers logistics collection and payment services, including credit cards, ATM teller machines, network ATMs and convenience store barcodes. It also provides logistics, electronic invoices, information security, card swiping machine, and project system construction services, mobile payments, and bank gateway systems. Green World Fintech Service Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
